checks.detail: the checklist was turned into a table

answer:
Done. I rebuilt the Lisbon trip packing Page to be VoiceOver-friendly with real labeled checkboxes, headings, progress text, live status messages, large touch targets, and keyboard focus styles.

I also converted the packing data into a table so the Page can now add new packing items directly, as well as mark items packed/unpacked.

  "guide": "# Building Amber Notes pages

A page turns a note into a small app: a habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a reading log. The note's markdown is the data and stays the source of truth: the person can always flip to Text and see and edit every row. The page is a view and a remote control for that data. Deleting or replacing a page never loses data.
